info.title: Scarlet.Sass.Cli - Dart Sass as a .NET Tool
info.description: Run Dart Sass as a .NET tool: `dotnet sass ...`. Platform-specific packages embed the matching Dart Sass runtime, so `dotnet tool restore` pins Sass through .config/dotnet-tools.json. Every argument is forwarded to Sass verbatim.

options.name: --load-path
options.description:
A path to use when resolving imports.
May be passed multiple times.

options.name: --pkg-importer
options.description: Built-in importer(s) to use for pkg: URLs.

options.name: --source-map-urls
options.description:
How to link from source maps to source files.
-q, --[no-]quiet               Don't print warnings.

options.name: --fatal-deprecation
options.description: Deprecations to treat as errors. You may also pass a Sass

options.name: --future-deprecation
options.description: Opt in to a deprecation early.

options.name: --watch
options.description: Watch stylesheets and recompile when they change.

options.name: --interactive
options.description:
Run an interactive SassScript shell.
-c, --[no-]color               Whether to use terminal colors for messages.

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the version of Dart Sass.
